title: Pan-release conflict gate is vacuous: the moved-check suppression cannot fail the test
evidence:
dispatch_frame(&ictx, []Device_Event{Device_Event(Mouse_Release{pos = {750, 550}, button = .Left})})
	testing.expect(t, !ictx.panning, "the release closes the pan latch")
	testing.expect(t, len(log) == 0, "the pan produced no commands")
	testing.expect(t, ictx.sel_pipe == -1 && ictx.sel_node == -1, "a panned release never click-selects (the moved-check suppresses the Select)")
--- exec.odin:161-171 (read at the reviewed sha) ---
	case Select:
		moved := rl.Vector2Distance(v.pos, inp.press) > 6
		if !inp.press_swallowed && !moved && !release_ui_hit(inp, v.pos) {
			click_select(inp, v.pos)
		}
--- the same file pins empty-ground click_select as a deselect ---
	testing.expect(t, ictx.sel_node == -1, "a click (no movement) on empty ground still deselects — the pan gate never eats a click")
detail: Nothing is selected beforehand and the release lands on empty ground; a regressed moved-check would still click_select into a deselect, so sel stays -1 — the pin cannot fail.
recommended_fix: Pre-select a node, pan >6px, release on empty ground, assert the selection survives; or release over a node and assert it is not selected.

title: NOC wheel-ownership policy (scroll only over the panel) has zero test coverage
detail: The acceptance item 'NOC wheel-ownership respected' (also a lens-guard) has zero pins; noc_panel_hit is pure float math and app-layer tests already run in gate 2 (settings_test.odin pattern).
recommended_fix: Pin noc_panel_hit boundaries (on/edge/outside) and the effect_zoom policy: over-panel wheel scrolls without zooming; off-panel zooms; panel_open blocks both.

title: Two-finger touch pan is only proven inert: no test anywhere asserts it pans
detail: Parity asserts only that touch pan is a no-op (hooks nil) — it passed identically under the old deliberate no-op; no test asserts Two_Finger_Pan produces Pan payloads or camera movement.
recommended_fix: Add a dispatch_frame test driving Two_Finger_Pan{dx,dy} with a recording on_pan hook; assert the exact pan deltas fire (mirror the mouse pin).

title: PP_CAM_E2E drive is manual-only (no gate runs it) and undocumented in run-dev.sh
evidence:
tools/ci-local.sh GATES (read whole at the reviewed sha — 11 gates; the PP_DEBUG gate only compiles, never runs the drive):
  "PP_DEBUG overlay builds (compile gate)|odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:app-debug.bin && odin build harness -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/harness-debug"
tools/run-dev.sh:38 documents only the NOC drive:
  PP_NOC_E2E=1 ./bin/app-dev
Repo-wide grep for CAM_E2E/PP_CAM at the reviewed sha: matches only in app/main.odin.
detail: No gate, script, or workflow sets PP_CAM_E2E; unlike PP_NOC_E2E it is not even documented in tools/run-dev.sh — the zoom/pan captures are one-shot manual evidence.
recommended_fix: Document PP_CAM_E2E=1 in tools/run-dev.sh beside PP_NOC_E2E, or add a harness verb that runs the drive and diffs the two captures.

title: Pan-latch lifecycle hardening untested: begin_draw clear, start_run reset, poll missed-release guard
detail: No test arms the latch then crosses begin_draw/start_run; the poll missed-release guard needs a real device and the e2e injects Device_Events past poll, so it never runs either.
recommended_fix: In camera_input_test: arm the latch via an empty press, call begin_draw, assert panning==false; document the poll guard as device-only (untestable headless).

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
evidence:
- New pins: 4 camera-math tests (app/render/camera_test.odin) + 4 input
  wiring tests (app/input/camera_input_test.odin) — the pan/draw/click
  conflict gates, the wheel chain, and the zoom anchor/clamp math.
detail: P0 100% (7/7: camera math, mouse wheel/pan chains, draw/click survival, goldens). P1 76% (3.8/5: vacuous pan-release gate; touch pan unasserted). Overall ~61% (11/18: policy/latch layer uncovered).
recommended_fix: Make the pan-release pin bite, assert touch Pan payloads via a recording hook, and pin noc_panel_hit/effect_zoom — raises P1 ≥90% and overall ≥80%.
